<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>Preamble</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> DWI, within the framework of its research and development work
at the Department <I>Advanced Materials for Biomedicine</I>, has developed the invention entitled <B>&ldquo;Space-Gel; Spacer Hydrogel
for Organ Shielding During Radiation Treatment of Prostate Carcinoma&rdquo;</B>, through the inventors <B>Mr. Andreas Kr&uuml;ger</B>
(inventor share: 34%), <B>Prof. Dr.-Ing. Laura de Laporte</B> (inventor share: 33%), and <B>Dr. rer. nat. Jens K&ouml;hler</B> (inventor
share: 33%) (DWI file reference: DW-LD015; hereinafter the &ldquo;INVENTION&rdquo;). </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The INVENTION was reported to DWI on <B>11 January 2023</B> and
claimed by DWI on <B>13 January 2023</B>. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> DWI is interested in commercial exploitation of the INVENTION and
of any resulting or derived <B>applications for intellectual property rights and intellectual property rights themselves</B> (hereinafter
collectively referred to as &ldquo;TECHNOLOGY&rdquo;) by way of a license grant. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> CS, as a company engaged in consulting services, manufacturing,
and distribution of medical devices, is interested in the <B>commercial utilization</B> of the TECHNOLOGY. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The terms and conditions of the future use of the TECHNOLOGY shall
be governed by the following agreements between the Parties:&nbsp;&nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 1 Subject Matter of the Agreement</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The subject matter of this Agreement consists of the <B>contractual
protective rights</B> as set forth in <B>Annex 1</B> of this License Agreement. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The subject matter further consists of any <B>additional protective
rights</B> that arise from those listed in Annex 1 through <B>nationalization, regionalization, or validation</B>. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 2 Contractual Products</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Contractual products within the meaning of this Agreement are all
<B>hydrogel spacers</B> manufactured by the Licensee <B>using the license to the subject matter of the contract</B>. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 3 Granting of License</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 1. </TD><TD> The Licensor grants to the Licensee an <B>exclusive</B>, <B>non-transferable</B>
                                            license, </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 35.55pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.95pt"> o </TD><TD> materially limited to the <B>field of application of prostate
                                            cancer</B>, </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 35.55pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.95pt"> o </TD><TD> temporally limited to the <B>duration of this Agreement</B>,
                                            and </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 35.55pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.95pt"> o </TD><TD> territorially limited to the <B>territorial scope of the contractual
                                            protective rights</B>,<BR>
                                            to <B>manufacture and have manufactured</B>, to <B>offer</B>, to <B>place on the market</B>,
                                            and to <B>use</B> the contractual products, and to <B>possess</B> them for these stated purposes,
                                            and to offer <B>services relating to the contractual products</B> subject to the aforementioned
                                            material, temporal, and territorial restrictions. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> In the event that one or more contractual protective rights lapse
in one or more of the countries included in the territorial scope, <B>the exclusivity shall remain in effect</B> until the last contractual
protective right in that country expires or becomes invalid. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 2. </TD><TD> The Licensor retains the right, alongside the Licensee, to use
                                            the contractual protective rights <B>for teaching purposes and for internal as well as publicly
                                            funded research</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 3. </TD><TD> The Licensee is entitled, <B>with the consent of the Licensor</B>,
                                            to grant sublicenses. The Licensee shall inform the Licensor of intended sublicenses.<BR>
                                            If the Licensor does not object within <B>two weeks</B> of receipt of the relevant notification,
                                            consent to the granting of the sublicense shall be deemed given.<BR>
                                            The Licensor may refuse consent <B>only for important cause</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2px solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: left; width: 100%"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">&nbsp;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 4 License Fee</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 1. </TD><TD> The Licensee shall pay to the Licensor, as remuneration for the
                                            grant of license, <B>ongoing sales-based license fees</B> in accordance with the following
                                            scale.<BR>
                                            The term <I>sales</I> refers to <B>net sales prices</B>.<BR>
                                            The <I>net sales price</I> is the amount invoiced by the Licensee to its customers for each
                                            contractual product, <B>less</B> freight, packaging, insurance, taxes, and customs duties
                                            (<B>commissions, discounts, risk surcharges, etc. shall not be deductible</B>). </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The claim arises upon <B>delivery of the contractual products</B>
by the Licensee.<BR>
If the Licensee takes back contractual products already delivered, it remains obligated to pay the license fee already accrued.<BR>
Upon redelivery of such products, no additional license fee shall arise. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 2. </TD><TD> The <B>sales-based license fees</B> amount to: </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 35.55pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.95pt"> o </TD><TD> <B>3% of the net sales price</B> (as defined in paragraph 1)
                                            until the cumulative sales-based license fees paid reach <B>EUR 400,000.00</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 35.55pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.95pt"> o </TD><TD> Once the cumulative sales-based license fees exceed EUR 400,000.00,
                                            the rate shall be <B>2.5%</B> for the portion of sales exceeding EUR 400,000.00. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 35.55pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.95pt"> o </TD><TD> When the cumulative sales-based license fees exceed <B>EUR 700,000.00</B>,
                                            the rate shall further reduce to <B>2%</B> for the portion exceeding EUR 700,000.00. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 3. </TD><TD> A. In the case of <B>granted sublicenses</B>, the Licensee shall
                                            pay to the Licensor <B>sales-based license fees equal to 50% of the revenues</B> received
                                            from sublicensing. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> B. For sublicenses granted to <B>affiliated companies</B> (within
the meaning of &sect;15 of the German Stock Corporation Act &mdash; <I>Aktiengesetz</I>), the license fees under &sect; 4(1) and (2)
shall be calculated <B>on the basis of the revenues generated by the sublicensee</B>.<BR>
License fees paid to the Licensor shall be <B>credited</B> toward the Licensee&rsquo;s total sales-based license fees. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 4. </TD><TD> The Licensee shall pay to the Licensor, as compensation for the
                                            <B>development work performed</B>, a <B>one-time lump-sum payment independent of sales</B>
                                            in the amount of <B>EUR 15,000.00 (fifteen thousand euros)</B>.<BR>
                                            This amount shall become <B>due upon execution of the Agreement</B>.<BR>
                                            It shall <B>not be refundable</B>, even in the event of early termination of the Agreement.<BR>
                                            It shall <B>not be credited</B> against ongoing license fees. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 5. </TD><TD> The Licensee additionally undertakes, for the duration of this
                                            Agreement, to pay an <B>annual minimum license fee</B> in the amount of <B>EUR 2,500.00 (two
                                            thousand five hundred euros)</B>.<BR>
                                            The minimum license fee shall be <B>due on February 1 of each year</B> for the preceding
                                            year.<BR>
                                            Payments already made under &sect; 4(1)&ndash;(3) shall <B>not be credited</B> against the
                                            minimum fee. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 6. </TD><TD> All payments under &sect; 4 shall be <B>denominated in euros</B>,
                                            and shall be <B>exclusive of applicable taxes and duties</B>.<BR>
                                            Should payments under this Agreement become subject to <B>value-added tax (VAT)</B> pursuant
                                            to &sect; 2b of the German VAT Act (<I>Umsatzsteuergesetz</I>), the Licensee shall pay the
                                            applicable VAT <B>in addition</B> to the agreed remuneration.<BR>
                                            Invoices issued in foreign currency shall be converted to euros at the <B>buying rate</B>
                                            valid at the Frankfurt Stock Exchange on the date of invoicing.<BR>
                                            Any <B>(bank) charges for payments from abroad</B> shall be borne by the Licensee. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 7. </TD><TD> Should a third party assert <B>prior user rights</B> in respect
                                            of one or more contractual protective rights, the Licensee&rsquo;s obligation to pay the
                                            license fee shall remain <B>unaffected</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 5 Accounting and Payment of the License Fee</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 1. </TD><TD> The <B>accounting period</B> shall be the <B>calendar year</B>.<BR>
                                            The accounting statement shall include <B>complete information</B> on sales achieved in the
                                            calendar year pursuant to &sect; 4(1) and (2), as well as all <B>quantities of contractual
                                            products delivered to customers</B> during that calendar year, and the <B>names and addresses
                                            of customers</B>.<BR>
                                            The Licensee shall submit the accounting statement <B>in text form</B> at the <B>end of January
                                            each year</B> for the preceding calendar year.<BR>
                                            If no sales were made during an accounting period, the Licensee shall notify the Licensor
                                            <B>in text form</B> accordingly. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 2. </TD><TD> The license fee resulting from the accounting statement shall
                                            be <B>paid within 30 days</B> of receipt of the corresponding invoice issued by the Licensor. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 3. </TD><TD> In the event of <B>late payment</B>, the outstanding amounts shall
                                            bear <B>interest at 9 percentage points above the base interest rate</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 4. </TD><TD> If the Licensor has given consent to the granting of sublicenses,
                                            the Licensee shall provide the Licensor with an accounting of the <B>sublicensees&rsquo;
                                            sales</B> as described in paragraph 1, and shall pay the resulting license fees to the Licensor
                                            <B>in accordance with &sect; 4(3)</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 5. </TD><TD> The Licensee shall maintain <B>books and records</B> of the sales
                                            of contractual products and revenues, keeping such documentation <B>separate from other company
                                            records</B>.<BR>
                                            The same shall apply to the sublicensees&rsquo; revenue data.<BR>
                                            The Licensor shall be entitled, at reasonable intervals, and up to <B>one year after termination</B>
                                            of the Agreement, to <B>inspect all books, accounts, invoices, and other documents</B> directly
                                            or indirectly relating to license fee accounting, and to have them <B>audited by an independent
                                            tax advisor or auditor</B> bound to confidentiality toward the Licensee.<BR>
                                            These rights shall also extend to the sublicensees.<BR>
                                            The costs of such audits shall be borne by the Licensee. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 6 Obligation to Exercise</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The Licensee shall <B>exercise the license right</B> and use <B>best
efforts</B> to commercialize the contractual products.<BR>
Commencement of production is targeted by <B>December 31, 2030</B>.<BR>
The Licensee shall provide the Licensor with <B>proof in text form</B> of the commencement of production no later than <B>four weeks
after production begins</B>.<BR>
If production has not commenced by the specified date, the Licensor shall have the right under <B>&sect; 13(3)(c)</B> of this Agreement. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>7 Approval</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The Licensee is hereby informed that, in certain countries belonging
to the <B>territorial scope of the contractual protective rights</B>, the contractual products <B>may not be placed on the market without
approval</B> from the relevant authorities. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Such approvals <B>do not currently exist</B>.<BR>
It shall be the <B>responsibility of the Licensee</B> to initiate and obtain such approvals from the competent authorities in the respective
countries and to <B>only place the contractual products on the market in each respective country</B> once the required approvals have
been granted. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The Licensee shall notify the Licensor of the submission of an
approval application by <B>sending a copy of the application</B>. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The Licensor shall support the Licensee within the framework of
the approval procedure.<BR>
However, the Licensor <B>assumes no liability</B> for obtaining such approvals in any of the countries included in the contractual territory. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 8 Publications</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The Licensor alone shall be entitled to <B>scientific publication</B>.<BR>
<B>No prior coordination or agreement with the Licensee</B> shall be required. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 9 Application and Maintenance of the Contractual Protective
Rights / Waiver / Opt-out and/or Opt-in</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 1. </TD><TD> <B>A.</B> The Licensor shall, during the term of this Agreement,
                                            <B>maintain the contractual protective rights</B> in consultation with the Licensee and,
                                            upon the Licensee&rsquo;s request, shall undertake <B>subsequent filings</B> and <B>nationalizations,
                                            regionalizations, or validations</B>.<BR>
                                            All costs associated with the <B>application and maintenance</B> of the contractual protective
                                            rights and any <B>subsequent filings, nationalizations, regionalizations, or validations</B>
                                            shall be borne by the Licensee. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The Licensor shall issue the corresponding invoices in order to
obtain reimbursement of costs from the Licensee.<BR>
The Licensee shall <B>settle the invoice within 30 days</B> from the date of issue by the Licensor. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>B.</B> The Licensee shall have <B>control over the proceedings</B>
and may decide, in this connection, <B>whether and to what extent the contractual protective rights are to be continued and/or whether
limitations of the scope of protection are to be made</B>. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Subsequent filings or validations that the Licensee does <B>not
wish to undertake</B> shall <B>not be considered contractual protective rights</B> and may be executed <B>independently and at the Licensor&rsquo;s
own expense</B>. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 2. </TD><TD> The Licensee may have the application and maintenance of the contractual
                                            protective rights handled by a <B>law firm of its choice</B>.<BR>
                                            The Licensor shall, upon request of the Licensee, <B>engage such law firm</B>.<BR>
                                            Should the Licensor intend to <B>waive</B> one or more of the contractual protective rights,
                                            whether in whole or in part, it shall <B>first offer</B> such rights to the Licensee for
                                            <B>assumption</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 3. </TD><TD> The Licensor shall be entitled to <B>sell or transfer</B> the
                                            contractual protective rights to third parties.<BR>
                                            In such a case, the Licensor shall ensure that <B>all rights and obligations arising from
                                            this License Agreement are assumed by the third party</B>.<BR>
                                            Furthermore, the Licensor shall be obliged to <B>notify the Licensee</B> of the <B>name and
                                            address</B> of the purchaser of the contractual protective rights. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 4. </TD><TD> The declaration of an <B>Opt-out</B> pursuant to Article 83(3)
                                            of the <I>Agreement on a Unified Patent Court</I> shall be <B>exclusively reserved for the
                                            Licensor</B>.<BR>
                                            The same shall apply for the declaration of an <B>Opt-in</B> pursuant to Article 83(4) of
                                            the same Agreement. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 10 Warranty and Liability of the Licensor</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 1. </TD><TD> The Licensor declares that it has the <B>sole right of disposal</B>
                                            over the contractual protective rights. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 2. </TD><TD> The Licensee is aware of the <B>technical characteristics</B>
                                            of the contractual protective rights.<BR>
                                            The Licensor provides <B>no warranty</B> for possible <B>material or legal defects</B> of
                                            the products resulting from the contractual protective rights.<BR>
                                            Corresponding <B>warranty or rescission rights</B> of the Licensee are excluded.<BR>
                                            The Licensor further makes <B>no assurance</B> that the contractual protective rights are
                                            <B>free of defects</B>, <B>technically useful</B>, or <B>commercially exploitable</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 3. </TD><TD> The Licensor <B>accepts no liability</B> for the <B>legal validity</B>
                                            of the contractual protective rights and any resulting <B>applications or intellectual property
                                            rights</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 4. </TD><TD> The Licensor is <B>not aware</B> of any <B>third-party rights</B>
                                            conflicting with the contractual protective rights.<BR>
                                            However, the Licensor gives <B>no guarantee</B> that the use of the contractual protective
                                            rights will not <B>infringe upon third-party rights</B>, and therefore <B>assumes no liability</B>
                                            that the use of the contractual protective rights does not <B>interfere with third-party
                                            intellectual property</B>.<BR>
                                            The Licensor is likewise unaware of any <B>prior user rights</B> of third parties, for the
                                            absence of which it <B>accepts no liability</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Nevertheless, the Licensor assures that it is <B>not aware of any
circumstances</B> that could <B>jeopardize the existence or exploitation</B> of the contractual protective rights, particularly that: </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 49.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> o </TD><TD> no <B>prior art detrimental to novelty</B> is known to it, and </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 49.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> o </TD><TD> no <B>prior user rights</B> of third parties or other <B>dependencies</B>
                                            preventing unrestricted use are known. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp;&nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The Licensor also confirms that, up to the time of signing this
Agreement, it is <B>not aware of any third party</B> having applied for or announced or threatened <B>revocation or cancellation</B>
of the contractual protective rights. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 5. </TD><TD> The Licensor has <B>not conducted</B> any <B>search for prior
                                            rights</B> (<I>Schutzrechtsrecherche</I>) or <B>Freedom-to-Operate (FTO)</B> analysis.<BR>
                                            The Licensor is <B>under no obligation</B> to conduct such searches. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 6. </TD><TD> The Licensor <B>assumes no liability</B> for the <B>technical
                                            usability or performance</B> of the contractual products.<BR>
                                            The Licensee alone shall be <B>responsible for the proper manufacture</B> of the contractual
                                            products, as well as for the accuracy of <B>assembly and operating instructions</B>.<BR>
                                            The Licensee is obligated to <B>indemnify and hold harmless</B> the Licensor against any
                                            <B>claims arising from product liability or manufacturer liability</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 7. </TD><TD> Apart from the foregoing, <B>liability for minor negligent breaches
                                            of duty</B> is excluded. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 8. </TD><TD> <B>Liability for grossly negligent breaches of duty</B> shall
                                            be <B>limited in amount</B> to the <B>contractually typical and foreseeable damages</B> at
                                            the time of contract conclusion. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 9. </TD><TD> Liability for <B>indirect damages</B>, in particular <B>consequential
                                            damages</B> and <B>lost profits</B>, is excluded. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 10. </TD><TD> The <B>liability exclusions and limitations</B> stated above
                                            shall <B>not apply</B> to damages resulting from <B>injury to life, body, or health</B>,
                                            or to <B>claims under the Product Liability Act</B>, nor to <B>essential contractual obligations</B>
                                            (cardinal obligations). </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The Parties agree that the <B>cardinal obligations</B> of this
Agreement are <B>exhaustively set forth in &sect;&sect; 1&ndash;5</B>.<BR>
In the event of a breach of cardinal obligations due to <B>slight negligence</B>, liability shall be limited to the <B>contractually
typical and foreseeable damages</B> at the time of contract conclusion. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 11. </TD><TD> The above <B>limitations or exclusions of liability</B> shall
                                            not apply where they concern <B>damages resulting from injury to life, body, or health</B>,
                                            or <B>claims under the Product Liability Act</B>, nor shall they apply to <B>breaches by
                                            vicarious agents</B> (<I>Erf&uuml;llungsgehilfen</I>). </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 12. </TD><TD> Unless DWI is liable for <B>intentional misconduct</B>, any claims
                                            by the Licensee arising from <B>breach of duty or tort</B> shall <B>expire within one (1)
                                            year</B> from the statutory commencement of the limitation period. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 11 Joint Enforcement and Defense</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22.5pt"> 1. </TD><TD> In the event of <B>infringement of the contractual protective
                                            rights by a third party</B>, the following shall apply: </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> a) Each Party shall <B>inform the other Party</B> of any infringement
of the contractual protective rights that becomes known to it. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> b) In the event of infringement of one or more contractual protective
rights, the <B>Licensor shall have the primary right</B> to take action against the infringer.<BR>
The Licensee shall be obligated to provide the Licensor with <B>all information and assistance necessary</B> for the enforcement of claims. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> c) The <B>allocation of costs</B> for legal enforcement shall be
determined <B>in consultation</B> between the Parties. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> d) If the Licensor receives <B>proceeds from damages</B> or settlements
paid by the infringer, it shall remit such proceeds to the Licensee <B>in proportion to the cost contribution</B>. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> e) Should the Licensor <B>waive its right to pursue enforcement</B>,
it shall inform the Licensee thereof.<BR>
In that case, the Licensee shall be entitled to <B>take action against the infringer at its own expense</B>.<BR>
The same shall apply if the Licensor, after a <B>reasonable period</B>, beginning from the point when all relevant circumstances are
known, <B>has not initiated legal action</B>.<BR>
In such cases, <B>damages received from the infringer shall accrue solely to the Licensee</B>. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 2. </TD><TD> The Licensor shall <B>defend the contractual protective rights</B>
                                            against <B>third-party challenges</B>, such as <B>actions for nullity and/or cancellation
                                            requests</B>, on its own behalf and in <B>consultation with the Licensee</B>.<BR>
                                            The allocation of costs shall be agreed between the Parties.<BR>
                                            The Licensee&rsquo;s <B>obligation to pay license fees</B> remains <B>unaffected</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 3. </TD><TD> If the Licensee is <B>attacked by third parties</B> for infringement
                                            of intellectual property rights as a result of using the contractual protective rights, it
                                            shall <B>immediately notify the Licensor</B> and provide the Licensor with the opportunity
                                            to participate in any potential litigation.<BR>
                                            The Licensor shall not, however, be obligated to do so.<BR>
                                            Nonetheless, the Licensor shall <B>assist the Licensee</B> in conducting such litigation.<BR>
                                            The <B>costs</B> shall be borne by the <B>Licensee</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 12 Confidentiality</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 1. </TD><TD> The Parties mutually undertake to maintain <B>confidentiality</B>
                                            regarding all information and knowledge exchanged or to be exchanged <B>before or during
                                            the term</B> of this Agreement, as well as knowledge acquired concerning the <B>principles,
                                            methods, manufacture, new developments, improvements, and other details</B> relating to the
                                            contractual products and operational processes concerning the performance of the contract
                                            &mdash; even if such information is <B>not explicitly designated as secret or confidential</B>.<BR>
                                            This shall not apply where <B>disclosure is necessary</B> to obtain official authorizations
                                            or approvals, or if the Licensor is <B>legally required</B> to disclose such information
                                            by law or by judicial and/or regulatory order. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 2. </TD><TD> The obligation of confidentiality shall not extend to information
                                            for which the Licensee can <B>prove</B> that such information was <B>already publicly known</B>
                                            without its involvement at the time of conclusion of this Agreement, or that it was <B>made
                                            public by third parties</B>.<BR>
                                            It also shall not extend to information already <B>in possession of the Licensee</B> prior
                                            to disclosure by the Licensor.<BR>
                                            In such a case, the Licensee shall <B>immediately notify</B> the Licensor that such information
                                            was already known in whole or in part, and shall <B>provide appropriate evidence</B> thereof. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 3. </TD><TD> The Licensee may make the information accessible <B>only to such
                                            employees</B> for whom knowledge thereof is <B>indispensable for the manufacture</B> of the
                                            contractual products. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 4. </TD><TD> The Licensee shall impose this <B>confidentiality obligation</B>
                                            on <B>all of its employees</B> and <B>external third parties</B> who, by virtue of their
                                            activities, may gain knowledge of the contractual product capable of being utilized.<BR>
                                            This confidentiality obligation shall, to the extent legally permissible, also be <B>imposed
                                            on employees for the period following termination</B> of their employment contract, and shall
                                            be <B>secured by a contractual penalty clause</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 5. </TD><TD> The obligation of confidentiality shall remain in effect for a
                                            <B>period of five years beyond the term of this Agreement</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 13 Term of the Contract</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 1. </TD><TD> This Agreement shall <B>enter into force</B> upon the <B>final
                                            signature</B> by both Parties. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 2. </TD><TD> The Agreement shall initially have a term until <B>31 March 2029</B>.<BR>
                                            The Agreement shall be <B>automatically extended</B> unless it is <B>terminated by the Licensee</B>
                                            by <B>30 September 2028</B>.<BR>
                                            If no termination occurs, the Agreement shall expire upon the <B>expiration of the last contractual
                                            protective right</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 3. </TD><TD> Notwithstanding the foregoing, <B>each Party</B> shall have the
                                            right to <B>terminate the Agreement without notice for good cause</B>.<BR>
                                            The Parties agree that <B>good cause</B> shall exist in particular if: </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> a) The Licensee <B>fails to submit</B> the required <B>applications
for approval</B> of the contractual products under &sect; 7;<BR>
b) The Licensee is <B>in default for more than three months</B> with <B>accounting and/or payment of license fees</B>, despite a reminder
and a <B>written grace period of six weeks</B>;<BR>
c) The Licensee, despite warning and a <B>written grace period of six months</B>, <B>fails to fulfill its obligation</B> to exercise
the license and commence production under &sect; 6, or later <B>suspends exercise</B> of the license for a period of six months;<BR>
d) Either Party, despite warning and a reasonable grace period, <B>violates other essential contractual obligations</B>;<BR>
e) The <B>majority shareholding structure</B> of either Party changes in such a way that <B>more than 50% of the voting rights</B> are
held by another participant, and as a result of the changed ownership, it is <B>unreasonable for the other Party to continue</B> the
Agreement.<BR>
A merely <B>indirect change in ownership</B> in the Licensee shall <B>not generally justify termination</B>. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 4. </TD><TD> In the event of termination of the Agreement pursuant to paragraph
                                            3, the Licensee shall <B>no longer be entitled</B>, upon the effectiveness of termination,
                                            to <B>sell or deliver</B> already produced contractual products. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 5. </TD><TD> Upon termination pursuant to paragraph 3, the Licensee shall <B>return
                                            to the Licensor</B> all documents concerning the contractual products received from the Licensor
                                            at the beginning and during the term of this Agreement. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 6. </TD><TD> In the event of termination <B>by DWI</B>, DWI shall <B>assume
                                            the Licensee&rsquo;s position</B> in any existing <B>sublicense agreements</B> and continue
                                            them with the sublicensees.<BR>
                                            The Licensee hereby <B>declares its consent</B> to the transfer of all <B>contractual rights
                                            and obligations</B> arising from sublicenses to DWI, and DWI <B>accepts this transfer</B>.<BR>
                                            The Parties agree that DWI&rsquo;s obligation to assume shall apply <B>only to sublicenses</B>
                                            that <B>solely concern the subject matter of this Agreement</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>Mixed contracts</B>, such as sublicenses combined with <B>service
and/or production agreements</B> or similar contracts, shall not be affected.<BR>
Such contracts with sublicensees or third parties shall <B>end upon termination</B> of this Agreement.<BR>
The Licensee shall ensure that this is <B>stipulated</B> in its sublicense or third-party agreements by including <B>appropriate provisions</B>. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> In the event of termination <B>by the Licensee</B>, DWI shall <B>not
assume</B> any sublicense agreements.<BR>
These agreements shall <B>end upon termination</B> of this Agreement.<BR>
The Licensee must also provide <B>corresponding clauses</B> in its sublicense or third-party contracts. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 7. </TD><TD> Payments already made under this Agreement shall <B>remain unaffected</B>
                                            by termination. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 8. </TD><TD> Any termination of this Agreement shall be <B>effective only in
                                            written form</B> and must be <B>delivered by registered mail</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 14 Prohibition of Assignment</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> This Agreement and the rights and obligations regulated herein
<B>may not be transferred</B> by either Party to third parties <B>without the consent</B> of the other Party.<BR>
&sect; 9 paragraph 3 shall remain unaffected. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>



<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 15 Collateral Agreements, Written Form, Export Control,
and Applicable Law</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 1. </TD><TD> <B>No collateral agreements</B> have been made. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 2. </TD><TD> <B>General terms and conditions</B> of the Licensee shall <B>not
                                            form part of this Agreement</B>, even if known, unless their validity has been <B>expressly
                                            agreed to in writing</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 3. </TD><TD> <B>Amendments and supplements</B> to this Agreement must be made
                                            <B>in writing</B> in order to be legally effective.<BR>
                                            This also applies to any <B>waiver of the written form requirement</B> itself.<BR>
                                            The <B>primacy of individual agreements</B> (&sect; 305b German Civil Code, <I>BGB</I>) shall
                                            remain unaffected. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 4. </TD><TD> The Licensee is aware that the contractual protective rights <B>may
                                            be subject to export control regulations</B> of the Federal Office for Economic Affairs and
                                            Export Control (<I>Bundesamt f&uuml;r Wirtschaft und Ausfuhrkontrolle</I>).<BR>
                                            Any <B>transfer of contractual protective rights abroad</B>, in any form &mdash; such as
                                            <B>granting licenses, sale of the contractual protective rights, or publication</B>, as well
                                            as the <B>transfer of products</B> manufactured on the basis of the contractual protective
                                            rights &mdash; may be <B>subject to export control</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 5. </TD><TD> This Agreement shall be governed by the <B>laws of the Federal
                                            Republic of Germany</B>, to the <B>exclusion of conflict of laws rules</B> and the <B>United
                                            Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG)</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 6. </TD><TD> The <B>Annexes</B> form an <B>integral part</B> of this Agreement.<BR>
                                            In the event of an <B>unintentional discrepancy</B> between the provisions of this Agreement
                                            and those of the Annexes, the <B>provisions of this Agreement shall prevail</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 16 Place of Performance and Jurisdiction</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 1. </TD><TD> The <B>place of performance</B> shall be <B>Aachen</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 2. </TD><TD> The Parties shall at all times engage in <B>discussion and exchange</B>
                                            regarding all questions and disagreements in connection with this Agreement.<BR>
                                            Should an <B>amicable settlement</B> fail, the Parties agree that the <B>exclusive place
                                            of jurisdiction</B> for all legal disputes arising from or in connection with this Agreement
                                            shall be <B>Aachen</B>. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&sect; 17 Final Provisions</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 1. </TD><TD> Should any provision of this Agreement be or become <B>invalid
                                            or unenforceable</B>, the <B>validity of the remaining provisions</B> shall not be affected. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 2. </TD><TD> The invalid or unenforceable provision shall be <B>replaced</B>
                                            by a provision that is <B>legally permissible</B> and that <B>most closely reflects</B> the
                                            intent of the original provision. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> 3. </TD><TD> The same shall apply in the event of a <B>gap</B> in the Agreement. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>
